packages/api/src/routers/project.ts.purpose: Project CRUD oRPC router with list, get, create, update, delete procedures. Each uses protectedProcedure, Zod input validation, repository integration, and ORPCError for error handling. Settings field uses type cast from Zod object to Record<string, unknown> for Drizzle compatibility.

procedures.create: Create new project with UUID, name, path, optional settings
procedures.update: Update project fields (partial, requires at least one field)

keyPatterns: crypto.randomUUID() for ID generation in create
Type cast: input.settings as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
Update builds updateData conditionally based on defined fields
Error detection by message content for NOT_FOUND vs BAD_REQUEST

packages/api/src/routers/feature.ts.purpose: Feature CRUD oRPC router with 7 procedures (list, get, create, update, delete, updateStatus, bulkUpdateStatus). Includes VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine for status change validation. Each procedure uses protectedProcedure, Zod input validation, repository integration, and ORPCError for error handling.

procedures.list: List all features or filter by status/phase (no input returns all)
procedures.create: Create new feature with UUID, title, description, acceptanceCriteria, phase, projectId, etc.
procedures.update: Update feature fields (partial, requires at least one field)
procedures.updateStatus: Update single feature status with transition validation
procedures.bulkUpdateStatus: Update status for multiple features with transition validation for all

keyPatterns: VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine maps current→allowed next states
crypto.randomUUID() for ID generation in create
Update builds updateData conditionally (filter undefined fields)
bulkUpdateStatus pre-validates ALL transitions before updating ANY
Transition validation throws BAD_REQUEST with detailed error message

packages/api/src/routers/index.ts.purpose: App router aggregation with all procedures. Exports appRouter (router object), AppRouter (type), and AppRouterClient (client type for type-safe frontend calls)

procedures.features: featureRouter sub-namespace for feature CRUD with state machine
procedures.sessions: sessionRouter sub-namespace for session CRUD with status transitions and output streaming

packages/api/src/routers/session.ts.purpose: Session CRUD oRPC router with 9 procedures (list, get, create, update, delete, listActive, updateStatus, appendOutput, getDuration). Includes VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine for session status validation (pending→running→completed|failed). Entity-specific operations for streaming output and duration calculation.

procedures.list: List all sessions or filter by status/featureId (optional input)
procedures.get: Get single session by SessionIdSchema, enriches with calculated duration
procedures.create: Create new session with UUID, featureId, status (default PENDING), startedAt
procedures.update: Update session fields (partial, requires at least one field: completedAt, output, error)
procedures.listActive: Get all active sessions (status IN [PENDING, RUNNING])
procedures.updateStatus: Update single session status with transition validation (pending→running, running→completed|failed)
procedures.appendOutput: Stream/append text output to session.output via SQL CASE WHEN concatenation
procedures.getDuration: Calculate elapsed time from startedAt to completedAt (or current time if still running)

keyPatterns: VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine maps current→allowed next states (pending→[running,failed], running→[completed,failed], completed→[], failed→[])
crypto.randomUUID() for ID generation in create
Update builds updateData conditionally (filter undefined fields)
calculateDuration helper enriches responses with elapsed time
appendOutput uses repository.appendOutput() for safe SQL CASE WHEN concatenation
